title: Back to School with Cogent
summary: Cogent is one of the world's largest Internet Service Providers, delivering high-quality Internet, Ethernet and Colocation services.
body_markdown:
*September 9, 2026 byHayley Levine*


[Education is the backbone of any successful society. It drives progress in the areas that let society flourish, from architecture and healthcare to technology. And one constant in education has always been the willingness to embrace what's new, especially when it comes to technology. From one-room schoolhouses to modern university campuses, education has always looked toward the future. The Internet is a big part of that future. As the Internet reshaped how we learn, moving education from heavy textbooks to instant global access to information, Cogent has spent more than 25 years helping bring that technology to students.](https://www.cogentco.com/cogent-blog/5123-back-to-school-with-cogent)


[Read on for more](https://www.cogentco.com/cogent-blog/5123-back-to-school-with-cogent)


Reliable Internet access now shapes almost every part of a student's day. Students research assignments, attend online classes, tap into digital libraries, collaborate with classmates in real time, and take assessments that give them feedback in minutes. Each of those depends on a connection that holds up under pressure. When the network slows down, learning slows down with it.


That pressure adds up fast. When thousands of students write essays, run research, and stream video at the same time, high-capacity bandwidth keeps everything moving without a hitch. Cogent's[Dedicated Internet Access](https://cogentco.com/en/products-and-services/internet/dedicated-internet-access) delivers that bandwidth to K-12 schools, colleges, and universities across the country. Cogent reaches these institutions through a third-party last mile provider or directly through the more than 1,900 data centers and over 1800 On-Net office buildings where Cogent provides service.


Connectivity no longer stops at the campus edge. Educational institutions are moving workloads, student information systems, and learning platforms to the cloud, and that migration needs a clean on-ramp. Cogent connects schools to[major cloud providers](https://cogentco.com/en/solutions/cloud-connect-solutions) including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, which makes the transition to cloud-based tools straightforward.


Beyond Dedicated Internet Access, Cogent supports education with a broader set of products. Schools that need to expand their address space can turn to Cogent for IPv4. Institutions running high-bandwidth research or connecting campuses and data centers can use[Optical Wave Services](https://cogentco.com/en/products-and-services/transport/optical-wave-services) for dedicated point-to-point capacity. Many education and research consortiums utilize wave services to share data and other information with other participating schools in the consortium. It also is the fastest way to access applications and data stored in the cloud. And for schools that want to house their own equipment, Cogent offers[colocation](https://cogentco.com/en/products-and-services/colocation) .


Cost matters as much as capacity, and there are many government programs and consortiums, such as E-Rate and The Quilt, to help schools stretch their budgets. Cogent has been a participant in both E-Rate and The Quilt for over 25 years, giving schools, colleges and universities a path to Cogent's Internet services at an affordable price point.


Through E-Rate, the FCC's universal service program administered by USAC, eligible schools and libraries receive discounts on broadband and Internet access. Established in 1996, E-Rate is the government's largest educational technology program, and it has helped bring Internet access to nearly every school and library in the country.


The Quilt plays a different role. It is a national coalition of non-profit U.S. regional research and education networks, whose mission is to advance research and education through network services and applications. Its members deliver advanced network services to over 900 universities and thousands of other educational and community institutions. Both give schools, colleges and universities a path to Cogent's Internet services at an affordable price point.


Technology is a core part of education in 2026, and having a provider that can support a school's goals matters. The right Internet partner lets educators stay focused on their students, not their connectivity.


Check out how schools utilize Cogent's services:[https://cogentco.com/en/component/tags/tag/education](https://cogentco.com/en/component/tags/tag/education)
